question.text: Moving averages are used in TA to:

answer.text: Smooth day-to-day price fluctuations to identify the trend

explanation.text: The Logic: Page 53 states chartists use moving averages to reduce the impact of day-to-day price fluctuations that may make trend identification difficult. The Trap: Dividends, intrinsic value, and ROE are not technical-analysis outputs. Note: Source-backed by NISM-XXI-A page 53.
